## Acceptance Criteria Cross-Check (against ADR-0012/ADR-0013, not re-derived here)
- **era-reset preserves meta-bonus across save/load** — `burnout_persistence_test.gd` round-trips `serialize_state()`/`restore_state()`; confirmed present by the Sprint 12 gate-check's Technical Director review (2026-07-23), not re-verified fresh by this pass.
- **Choice A vs Choice B distinct paths, no grant machinery on Defer** — `prestige_defer_test.gd`'s static source-scan (updated this sprint for the ADR-0017 rename, see Sprint 12 commit `05d74f5`).
- **Challenge selection caps at CHALLENGE_MAX_ACTIVE=3** — `challenge_selection_storage_test.gd`, file presence confirmed, not executed by this review.

## Smoke Test Scope
No dedicated smoke report exists for Sprint 11 — same gap as Sprint 10, same remedy (Sprint 12 story 12-1).

## Playtest Requirements
**None were run.** The era loop's backend shipped without a single human playing it end-to-end during Sprint 11 — this is the exact gap that failed the Production→Polish gate-check twice (2026-06-24 and 2026-07-23). Sprint 12 story 12-3 is the first scheduled playtest of this system, and it was blocked until 12-2 (challenge-selection UI) shipped — which it did, 2026-07-24.
